name: Furvise novel care 15

history.algorithm: md5(string_agg(row_to_json(e)::text,'' order by id)) over all account care entries

novelty: Compared against all retained account user messages; new care topics/date combinations. Older deleted conversations cannot be exhaustively verified.

rubric.pass: All required facts correct, grounded, no invented claims.
rubric.partial: Correct substantive response but required fact omitted.
rubric.fail: Incorrect fact or says available record absent.
rubric.error: No substantive terminal response within 120 seconds or application error.
